metadata.purpose: Review-only Arabizi support assets. Production routing vocabulary remains data/knowledge_base/arabizi_vocabulary.json.
guardrails: No section in this file may directly promote production routing terms.
general_word_bank blocks routing_prediction, severity_decision, and issue_type_decision.
variant_lookup must keep use_for_routing_prediction_now=FALSE until explicit review.

oov_seed_queue rows are review seeds, not production corpus evidence.
arabizi_protected_combos.csv defines phrase locks that must be matched BEFORE single-token lookup — prevents false positive routing from component tokens.
External Lebanese OOV candidates are review-only and cannot be promoted without native review, source permission compatibility, and layer-specific validators.
metadata.architecture_note: V12 architecture overhaul: general_word_bank and protected_combos have been materialised as reviewable CSV files. The JSON sections remain the authoritative consolidated source; CSV files are the human-review-ergonomic projection. Central rule: domain vocab votes on routing; generic vocab provides context only; protected combos override naive token splitting.

arabizi_protected_combos.csv.rule: Phrase locks — combined meaning is lost if tokens are split. Overrides naive tokenisation.

stoplist.reason: WRONG_FORM — not a standard Lebanese Arabizi word for water. Use 'may' (standard Beirut/Levant form). miye was mistakenly added in v1.5.0 expansion.
WRONG_FORM — does not correspond to any Lebanese Arabic word. The correct adjective for 'cut' is 2at3a (قطعة) or the verb 2ata3et. Forms like 'kahraba mat3a' and 'may mat3a' were removed in v1.5.1.
WRONG_FORM — not a valid Lebanese Arabizi spelling for طريق (road). The correct form is tari2 (already in production vocabulary since v1.4.0).
NON_WORD — does not exist in Lebanese Arabic. No equivalent. For bad/foul smell use: ri7a besh3a / ri7a bish3a / ri7a mish taybe / ri7a msh mni7a. Added to v1.5.1.
WRONG_FORM — 'mayyet' (ميت) means 'dead' in Arabic. NOT a word for water. Possibly confused with 'may' (water) or 'mayye' (regional variant). Always reject.

FALSE_FRIEND — '3ain' (عين) means 'eye' and also 'spring/source' depending on context. In CedarFix's Lebanese municipal context prefer nab3 (spring) or beer may (well) for water source. 3ain without context may trigger false positives or misroute. Reject as standalone production keyword.

CANDIDATE_ONLY — regional spelling variant heard in Beqaa and South Lebanon. NOT the Beirut standard. Do not promote to production core. Keep in candidate bank only if evidence from those regions is needed.
